en: A color-tinted vintage postcard showing a rural scene on a hilly island covered with pine trees. In the foreground is an open sandy or dirt area with a few people; one person leads a loaded pack animal while another stands nearby. A road and low stone wall separate the open space from denser trees and simple structures. The background is dominated by a forested hillside under a softly colored sky. Printed French text at the top mentions Constantinople and the Princes' Islands, and a website watermark appears at the bottom.
